name: Shiori - Bookmark Manager
tagline: Shiori is a bookmark manager that lives in your macOS menu bar
description: Shiori is a bookmark manager that lives in your macOS menu bar. Save, organize, and open your bookmarks without switching apps or opening a browser. You save links with tags, folders, and descriptions. Full-text search finds anything instantly — by title, URL, tag, or description. Saved Filters let you create custom views for specific combinations of tags and folders, so the right bookmarks are always in front of you. Keyboard-driven from the ground up.
